Vulnerabilities.Title: OpenSSH: regreSSHion remote unauthenticated code execution
Vulnerabilities.Description: A signal handler race condition in OpenSSH server (sshd) allows unauthenticated remote code execution as root.

Vulnerabilities.Title: xz: malicious code in distributed source
Vulnerabilities.Description: Malicious code was discovered in the upstream tarballs of xz, introducing a backdoor via liblzma affecting sshd.

Vulnerabilities.Title: curl: heap buffer overflow in the SOCKS5 proxy handshake
Vulnerabilities.Description: curl SOCKS5 heap buffer overflow when the hostname is longer than 255 bytes.

Vulnerabilities.Title: glibc: off-by-one buffer overflow in getcwd
Vulnerabilities.Description: An off-by-one buffer overflow and underflow in getcwd may lead to memory corruption.
